ad.title: App data location
ad.hint: Every app keeps its files in one folder on the data disk, with one folder per app inside it.
ad.off: Docker isn’t available on this server, so there’s no App data folder.
ad.root.label: App data folder
ad.root.hint: Moving stops the apps that use it, copies and checks every file, switches them to the new folder and starts them again. The old copy is kept until you remove it.
ad.root.confirmText: Apps using {from} are stopped while their files are copied to {to} and checked. They start again afterwards. The old copy stays until you remove it.
ad.root.fail: Couldn’t move the App data folder
ad.oldRoot.label: Old copy
ad.oldRoot.hint: The App data folder was moved. The old copy is still at {path}.
ad.oldRoot.confirmText: Everything in {path} is deleted. This can’t be undone.
ad.share.title: App data share
ad.share.hint: Reach the App data folder over the network from another computer.
ad.share.toggleHint: Administrators only. File Sharing (SMB) must be on.
ad.share.warn: Saved, but the share couldn’t be updated yet
ad.organize.title: Apps still using Docker volumes
ad.organize.hint: Move them into the App data folder so each has its own folder you can open in Files.
ad.cands.title: {n} app(s) still keep data in Docker volumes
ad.cands.hint: Move them into {root}, one folder per app. Nothing moves until you choose to.
ad.move.confirmTitle: Move {app} to the App data folder?
ad.move.confirmText: {app} stops while its files are copied to {dirs} and checked, then starts again with the folders. If anything fails it goes back to its volumes. The volumes are kept until you clean them up.
ad.all.confirmTitle: Move {n} apps to the App data folder?
ad.all.confirmText: Each app is stopped, copied into {root}, checked and started again, one at a time. An app that fails goes back to its volumes.
ad.job.done: Done. The old volumes are kept until you clean them up in Settings → Containers.
ad.old.title: Clean up old volumes
ad.old.hint: Volumes left behind after apps moved into the App data folder.
ad.old.confirmText: They hold {size}. The apps already use their App data folders. This can’t be undone.
ad.spec.hint: New folders go in the App data folder ({root}) by default.
ad.uninstall.title: Delete {app}’s data?
ad.uninstall.text: Its App data folder (settings, databases and files) is deleted for good. To confirm, type {id}.
ad.backup.label: App data
ad.backup.hint: Every app’s folder in the App data folder
ad.backup.stopHint: Databases are copied in a consistent state; apps are down for the backup
